tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch4:4.30Let $\gamma : I \to \mathbb {R}^n$ be a smooth curve, and let $V$ be a smooth vector field along $\gamma $. Show that $V$ is parallel along $\gamma $ with respect to the Euclidean connection if and only if its component functions (with respect to the standard basis) are constants. \end{exercise}
